name: makarasty-tools
description: Twenty-two everyday commands: commit and ship under your own name, review a diff with evidence, red-team a plan or change, finish a task in one command (review, red team, tests, commit, push), blind-test a screen with first-time-user agents, before/after screenshot reports, list what other chats left open, trash merged branches and worktrees undoably, a monthly review of your own chats, build tools by measured best practice, refactor and test with care, hand a chat off before its context runs out, collect bugs until a codeword, explain plainly, strip assistant tics from text, an antislop filter for UI work, phrase a vendor call in simple English, get a phone message when a chat finishes, tune the machine for a game, find what is worth updating and clean up what nobody uses. In-engine hooks suggest a handoff past 700k tokens of context, run plain-execution subagents on Sonnet, refuse git commands that throw away uncommitted work or skip hooks, recursive deletes of the project, home, a drive or .git, a second whole-suite test run while one is live, and live-looking secrets written into project files, note a command failing the same way three times, and send file reads to the Read and Grep tools.
